title: Selected project is replaced after restart
observed: Explicitly selecting B and restarting with a catalog containing only A restored A; Workspace could also label an unlisted active B as A.
impact: The next session can run in a different project from the developer’s last choice.
proposal: Retain explicit directory and remote workspace independently of catalog presence and refresh success; guard automatic initialization, serialize saves with deletion, and display the actual selected folder.
verification: Final scope/deletion run passed all 60 controller/SSE/deletion cases; final project UI run passed all 20 cases. Earlier Workspace hierarchy (15), profile store (8) and transport guard (2) are supporting coverage. Format/diff check passed. Integration analyzer and native relaunch remain pending.
